## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive (mixed/rotation). VXX (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -22.20%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND point to fading fear and risk appetite, while regime signals show credit stress rising (HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND), producing conflicting drivers.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -22.20%) BELOW TREND and stock/bond outperformance SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY) ↑ rising. Credit stress flagged higher via HYG/LQD (HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND) — a countervailing risk.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-loose broadly: UUP (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.83%) BELOW TREND and yield curve (Level 1.0641 | 1W: +0.23% | 1M: -1.89%) RECOVERY indicate modest easing. TLT (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY — monitor duration given mixed rate signals.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND and semis SOXX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +8.45%) ABOVE TREND showing momentum; Financials also strong (XLF proxy: 1W: +2.76% | 1M: +10.79%) ABOVE TREND. Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +0.37%) CORRECTION — style mixed given dual strength in tech and financials.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforming: SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +3.23%) ABOVE TREND. EM/China mixed — EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND while FXI (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -0.97%) RECOVERY and China vs US ratios falling.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation intact: IWM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +5.69%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +5.03%) ABOVE TREND. Crypto mixed: IBIT (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -2.19%) RECOVERY — risk-on flows but selective.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base/industrial metals and precious metals strong: CPER (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.35%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +8.23% | 1M: +39.87%) ABOVE TREND. Broad commodity reflation theme with PPLT (1W: +18.68% | 1M: +45.37%) ABOVE TREND notable.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed-to-weak: XLE (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +0.37%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: +2.87% | 1M: -0.93%) RECOVERY, while UNG (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND — watch downside in gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND — equity momentum confirmed. DIVERGENCE: multiple RECOVERY cases (TLT (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.47%), IBIT (1W: +1.54% | 1M: -2.19%), FXI (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -0.97%)) constitute a MAJOR divergence signal — suppress strong regime conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective equity exposure where momentum is clear (SPY (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit; reduce exposure to rate-sensitive/long-duration mismatches given mixed TLT (1W: +0.65% | 1M: -1.47%) RECOVERY signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +4.77%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.33% | 1M: +8.45%) ABOVE TREND if semis sustain. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +0.37%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: +0.87% | 1M: -3.24%) RECOVERY if defensives fail to hold.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: SLV (1W: +8.23% | 1M: +39.87%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND on reflation signals. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND for continued downside risk.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -22.20%) BELOW TREND near 27 — complacency if it drifts lower; watch HYG/LQD divergence as credit barometer (HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.59% | 1M: +0.12%) ABOVE TREND). XLK/XLF ratio (Level 2.6252 | 1W: +0.96% | 1M: -1.84%) RECOVERY as tech vs financial pivot metric.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive — mixed market with both risk-on cues and credit warning signs. XLK and broad equities (SPY, QQQ) showing strength while credit divergence and multiple RECOVERY signals (TLT/IBIT/FXI) are key risks to monitor.
